verdict.rationale: Deel's payroll pages claim "accurate, compliant payroll" with "automated compliance" across 150+ countries. That loosely implies payroll tax handling, but nothing explicitly describes calculating, filing, or remitting taxes at federal, state, or local level. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic payroll tax calculation, automated filing with tax agencies, remittance of tax payments, coverage of US federal/state/local jurisdictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
